name: What’s the best way to compare bids for a tub-to-shower conversion?

mainEntity.name: How should homeowners compare contractor bids for a tub-to-shower conversion so they do not choose the wrong one?
mainEntity.text: How should homeowners compare contractor bids for a tub-to-shower conversion so they do not choose the wrong one?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best way to compare bids is to make sure each contractor is pricing the same scope. One quote may look cheaper because it excludes demolition, waterproofing, plumbing upgrades, permit fees, or final glass installation. Another may include higher-grade materials, better drain work, or a more complete warranty. Homeowners should compare line items and ask what happens if hidden damage is found. It is also useful to ask who supplies the materials, what brand or product line is being used, and whether the contractor coordinates inspections. A strong bid should read like a complete plan, not a vague estimate. When comparing several contractors, look for clarity, not only price. If one bid is far lower than the others, that often means something important is missing. A well-documented estimate usually leads to fewer surprises and better results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare scope, materials, waterproofing, plumbing changes, permit handling, glass, cleanup, and warranty, not just total price. The cheapest bid is often missing important work, so each quote should be checked line by line for what is actually included.
